VBO:0201367.summary: Historical Toy Trawler Spaniels were described as bold and courageous, with an alert character. They were valued as ratters and rabbiters, alongside a smart, prancing style of movement. This small spaniel type had its own show classes and was distinguished from Cockers.
VBO:0201367.shortDescription: Bold, courageous and alert, historical Toy Trawler Spaniels were valued for ratting and rabbiting.
